models.author: geotessera
models.name: TESSERA-V-1.1
models.description: TESSERA v1.1 is a pixel-wise geospatial foundation encoder for multimodal Sentinel-1/2 time series. It produces task-agnostic temporal surface-spectrum embeddings for downstream Earth observation analysis. The v1.1 encoder uses a wider architecture than TESSERA v1, with latent_dim=192 and transformer d_model=768; its dim_reducer outputs a 192-dimensional representation, and the first 128 dimensions are saved for downstream use.
